github_integration.release_description: Initial public release of CurvTrust-PAI: residual pipeline, swarm trust/HOCBF filter, extracted tables and figures, and results summary.

deposit_metadata.title: CurvTrust-PAI: Reference-anchored neighbourhood-overlap residual for network intrusion analysis and trust-based safety filtering in multi-agent cyber-physical systems
deposit_metadata.description: CurvTrust-PAI evaluates a reference-anchored neighbourhood-overlap residual in two independent settings: (1) network-flow intrusion analysis (auxiliary feature + conformal detector) and (2) trust-conditioned safety filtering in a simulated multi-agent swarm. Shared residual; no run-time data exchange between modules. Repository includes code, tables, figures and results JSON. Public datasets are not redistributed.
